plain: Bob Lazar, a man known for his claims about secret UFO science, says that in the early 1980s he worked at Los Alamos, a US government science lab in New Mexico, on its linear accelerator, a big machine that speeds up tiny particles in a straight line. He says his job was building high voltage power supplies insulated with fiber optics. He tells it as part of his background, to show he really did hold technical government work.
